document.abstract: Parameter limits in high-speed camera design and physical characteristics of photographic images limit the assessment accuracy of high-speed metric film records. The errors in film measurements range from 2 to 75 microns. Proper design of field instrumentation is required to minimize effects of reading errors in a measurement system for ballistic data.
